jobs.title: Brand & Web Designer
jobs.description: Hi, I'm Rosa , Head of Brand at FeedbackFruits. 👋 As FeedbackFruits evolves, so does the role design plays in how we build and communicate our brand. Campaigns and marketing materials will always be part of the picture, but we're putting a much bigger focus on our website, our digital experiences and the brand systems that help us do better work, more consistently. I'm looking for a brand designer with a strong B2B marketing background, someone who combines excellent visual craft with real, hands-on website experience. You'll help evolve our visual identity, develop creative concepts for campaigns and launches, and bring that work to life on our website and landing pages, from the first layout to the moment a page goes live. The first project you'd pick up with me is one I'm particularly excited about: evolving our brand so it sits closer to the new visual language of our product. After that, you'll take ownership of our website and landing pages, shaping the direction together with me while owning the design and execution, and you'll make sure our brand shows up consistently wherever people come across us, from a launch campaign to an ebook. Beyond the design itself, I'm looking for someone who takes real ownership: someone who asks the right questions before jumping into a brief, spots what could be better and isn't afraid to challenge the obvious solution. We also use AI a lot at FeedbackFruits, and I'd love you to bring that same mindset to design, building templates and systems that help the whole team create on-brand work without starting from scratch every time. You'll have a real say in our creative direction, and as the team grows, there's room for you to grow with it. You work directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you sit in a cross-functional team with Engineering and Product. What you are expected to do: Build the system Architect the design system, tokens and components as the substrate AI generates against. jobs.title: Enterprise Migrations Practice Area Lead
jobs.description: About us Infinite Lambda is a data and AI consultancy that helps the world’s leading companies become data-first. We design and build modern, cloud-native data platforms, and we help our clients turn them into real business value with AI. We’re one of Europe’s fastest-growing consultancies, and we’re now a global team across three regions. Headquartered in London, we have engineers and consultants in the United States, the UK, France, Italy, Hungary, Slovakia, Romania, Bulgaria, Vietnam and Singapore. We’re also building new teams in Brazil, Argentina and Chile. Our mission is to bring exceptional people together to make an impact where technology meets sustainable growth. You’ll work alongside experts in dbt, Snowflake and the wider modern data stack on complex, meaningful projects, in a culture built on curiosity, experimentation and continuous learning. We’re a diverse team, and we want everyone to feel comfortable being themselves at work. If you want to grow fast, learn constantly and help shape where we go next, we’d love to hear from you. About the role Every enterprise wants to be AI-ready, and most are held back by legacy data estates built over decades. As Enterprise Migrations Practice Area Lead, you’ll own how Infinite Lambda solves that problem: moving the world’s largest organisations off Informatica, Talend, SSIS/SQL Server, DataStage, stored procedures and, increasingly, SAS and Alteryx, onto modern platforms ready for AI. Enterprise migrations are a core pillar of our growth strategy, and this role sets the standard for how we deliver them globally. The practice spans the full migration lifecycle: Assess: Estate discovery, feasibility analysis and migration strategy, ending in a fixed-cost, fixed-timeline proposal that gives clients certainty from day one. Convert: Automated code conversion with Flowline, our proprietary product, which combines deterministic and LLM-assisted methods. This stage also covers refactoring, optimisation and a first-pass

jobs.description: This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social. As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions. We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey! Side quest: Read this new page about making new games at Supercell. jobs.description: Who We Are Hi, we're DuckDuckGo, the online protection company and remote-first team of 300+ on a mission to raise the standard of trust online. Founded in 2008 and profitable since 2014, annual revenue now exceeds $100m USD and millions use our browser on on Mac , Windows , iOS , and Android , our search engine , and the DuckDuckGo subscription . We also offer private, useful, and optional AI, including Duck.ai , which lets you chat privately with ChatGPT, Claude, and other AIs, all in one place. Our culture of trust, inclusivity, and empowered project management underpins everything we do, where each team member takes full ownership of their projects, from scoping and execution to postmortem. If you're seeking end-to-end ownership of your work, you've come to the right place! Your Team and Role As a Senior Product Designer, Design Systems you'll be the first of its kind at DuckDuckGo. You'll take ownership of our design system at a pivotal moment, with a chance to define both a role and a roadmap from the ground up — helping build the process, not just step into one. You'll audit our existing system, lead projects that move it forward across platforms and products like Duck.ai and Search, as well as shape how we manage and scale it as we grow. Applying your hands-on design skills, you will autonomously lead highly impactful projects that scale across millions of users, and collaborate with team members at all levels to pioneer new solutions as we build out the privacy layer for the internet. From ideation to execution, you'll assess vague problems, propose high-impact solutions, and execute them against a set of success criteria. You'll have a voice in all product-related design decisions, whether large or small, and an opportunity to work on a team dedicated to our ethical, privacy by design approach.
